translation: Gathered as stems and leaves in the third month, dried in the shade; gathered as seeds in the fifth month. The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 青葙子 (qīngxiāngzǐ), flavor bitter, slightly cold. It governs evil-qi (邪氣), heat in the skin (皮膚中熱), wind-itching of the body (風瘙身癢), and kills the three worms (殺三蟲).
